messages.translation: Inakagua hifadhi ya mpango wa mazao
Mpango wa mazao ni wa kusoma pekee

messages.english: Saved records are being checked before crop-plan editing is enabled.
messages.translation: Kumbukumbu zilizohifadhiwa zinakaguliwa kabla ya kuruhusu uhariri wa mpango wa mazao.

messages.english: An older app session changed its previous copy. Your protected crop plan has been kept, and the two copies need review.
messages.translation: Kipindi cha zamani cha programu kilibadilisha nakala yake ya awali. Mpango wako wa mazao unaolindwa umehifadhiwa, na nakala zote mbili zinahitaji kupitiwa.

messages.english: Keep current plan; retain older copy for later review
messages.translation: Bakia na mpango wa sasa; hifadhi nakala ya zamani ili ipitiwe baadaye
Jaribu tena ukaguzi wa mpango wa mazao

messages.english: Your signed-out crop work is still being preserved. Retry its transfer before starting a different account plan; neither copy has been replaced.
messages.translation: Kazi yako ya mazao iliyofanywa kabla ya kuingia kwenye akaunti bado inahifadhiwa. Jaribu tena kuihamisha kabla ya kuanza mpango wa akaunti nyingine; hakuna nakala iliyobadilishwa.

messages.english: These counts do not verify planting records. Matching row counts do not mean the dates, quantities or settings match. The download contains your exact saved copies. This app does not upload them; keep the file private.
messages.translation: Idadi hizi hazithibitishi kumbukumbu za upandaji. Kulingana kwa idadi ya mistari hakumaanishi kuwa tarehe, viwango au mipangilio inalingana. Upakuaji huu una nakala zako halisi zilizohifadhiwa. Programu hii haizipakii mtandaoni; weka faili hii kwa faragha.

messages.english: Your protected plan is kept. The reviewed older copy is retained for later review; no older changes were merged.
messages.translation: Mpango wako unaolindwa umebaki. Nakala ya zamani iliyopitiwa imehifadhiwa ili ipitiwe baadaye; hakuna mabadiliko ya zamani yaliyounganishwa.
